pages.text: $(item)Harmonic of Alchemy$()$(br2)A frequency that carries the memory of a potion within it, ready to be released again and again.

$(bold)Attunement$()$(br)Unlike the other Harmonics, the Harmonic of Alchemy is not attuned by striking. It is created through the Resonance Chamber, a ritual structure that draws energy from stored potions, infusing them into an Unattuned Fork.$(br2)See the following page for how to build and use the Resonance Chamber.

$(bold)Use$()$(br)Right-click in the air to apply the stored potion effects to yourself, or right-click an entity to apply them instead. There is a lengthy cooldown between uses, so be mindful with how you use it.
